providers.name: arithmetic-tabular
providers.description: Classical 30-year-cycle arithmetic Hijri calendar (epoch JDN 1948440). Deterministic, offline, no external data. NOT an approximation of the official Umm al-Qura calendar specifically — typically within 1-2 days of it.

providers.name: umm-al-qura
providers.description: Astronomical approximation of the real Umm al-Qura calculation rule (lunar conjunction before Makkah Maghrib AND moonset after Makkah Maghrib). Validated against 4 independently-known historical Umm al-Qura New Year dates (2016, 2018, 2019, 2025), all exact. Has no channel for the real-world sighting-based adjustments Umm al-Qura sometimes applies to 1 Muharram, 1 Ramadan, 1 Shawwal and 1 Dhu al-Hijjah. See docs/CALENDARS.md.

providers.name: declared
providers.description: An institution's adopted date for one specific Gregorian date, supplied via override_date + declared_year/month/day. Falls back to arithmetic-tabular for any other date, and if no override is supplied at all.

providers.name: local-observation
providers.description: A reported moon sighting for one specific Gregorian date, supplied via override_date + sighting_year/month/day (+ optional observed_at location). Falls back to arithmetic-tabular for any other date, and if no sighting is supplied at all.

data.caveat: Waqt states calendar facts (which civil date, which Hijri date, which Waqt day/position), not institutional or religious obligations.
